means: Danbooru file metadata again, the bottom band - auto-applied to small uploads, under roughly 500px. Its training images are small, soft, often rescaled thumbnails.
does: In the positive it delivers precisely that: mushy detail, soft edges, upscaled-thumbnail texture. In the NEGATIVE it is the natural counterweight to absurdres and works reliably for the same structural reason - it is a metadata pole rather than a quality adjective, so the model has a clean direction to move away from. Standing negative here, always next to 'worst quality'.
reach_for_it: never in the positive. Keep it in the standing negative, paired with absurdres in the positive.
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short black hair, dark jacket, standing on a rooftop, city skyline behind, late afternoon sun, looking away, masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic, absurdres
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
